scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Papita Vikas Yojana
other_conditions: Minimum land holding of 0.25 acres (0.1 ha) and maximum of 10 acres (4 ha).
Must be registered on the DBT portal of the Agriculture Department.
Both ryot and non‑ryot farmers are eligible.
Selection is on a first‑come‑first‑serve basis.
Ryot farmers are selected based on land documents; non‑ryot farmers on a contract form.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to ₹33,750 per hectare in the first year and ₹11,250 per hectare in the second year, along with supply of high‑quality tissue‑cultured papaya plants.
